events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the world lost Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: A true legend of rock, Freddie Mercury's incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. We're celebrating his legacy today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' 61 years ago today in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Reflection
angles.copy: 'Rubber Soul' – the album that marked a real turning point for The Beatles. Still sounds incredible, doesn't it?

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who tragically passed away 46 years ago today in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: His music and message continue to resonate. Today, we remember the iconic John Lennon.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary David Bowie, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman at 80
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. We're celebrating the incredible, ever-evolving legacy of David Bowie.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935, would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: Hail the King
angles.copy: All hail the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his music still reigns supreme.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd to the legendary Jimmy Page! His guitar riffs shaped rock history.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop legend Sir Rod Stewart, born in 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Still Rocking
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Wishing Rod Stewart a very happy 82nd birthday.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs, born Graham McPherson in 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: One Step Beyond
angles.copy: It's the one and only Suggs' 66th birthday! Still bringing the house down after all these years.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The voice behind hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', Paul Young, born in 1956, celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young's Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! What a voice.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The iconic singer, songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton, born in 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: 9 to 5 Queen
angles.copy: She's still working 9 to 5! Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow, born in 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Mr. Take That
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! Still going strong after all these years.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The legendary British soul singer Billy Ocean, born in 1950, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Get Outta My Dreams
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and wish Billy Ocean a happy 77th birthday!

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: 38 years ago today, in 1989, the first ever Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony took place.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 38 years since the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame opened its doors to its first legends. Who's your favourite inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born in 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Still a vital part of one of the UK's biggest bands.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: 58 years ago today, in 1969, The Beatles played their iconic final live performance on the Apple Corps rooftop.

angles.name: Rooftop Legends
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for that legendary concert. Imagine being there!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins, born in 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil the Power
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins. A true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake, born in 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From *NSYNC to solo stardom.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason, born in 1940, beloved for roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, who tragically died in a plane crash 68 years ago today in 1959.

angles.name: Music Lives On
angles.copy: 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'. We remember the incredible talents lost too soon: Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley, born in 1966, known for his timeless hits, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Never gonna give up on wishing Rick Astley a very happy 61st birthday!

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley, born in 1945, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: One love. One heart. Bob Marley would have been 82 today, and his message of peace still resonates.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, born in 1942, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! Her songs are the soundtrack to so many lives.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston, who passed away 15 years ago today in 2012.

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: 15 years since we lost one of the greatest voices of all time. We're remembering Whitney Houston today.

events.title: Take That's Original Split Anniversary
events.blurb: 31 years ago today, in 1996, Take That announced their original split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Never Forget The Split
angles.copy: Remember where you were 31 years ago when Take That announced they were splitting? Thankfully, they came back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell, born in 1959, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Red Red Wine
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell from UB40! Still bringing those reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran, born in 1991, celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ed
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to our very own Ed Sheeran! What's your favourite Ed track?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The quiet Beatle, George Harrison, born in 1943, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Here Comes The Sun
angles.copy: We're thinking of George Harrison today, who would have been 84. His songwriting legacy shines on.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who's iconic frontman Roger Daltrey, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: The Voice of The Who
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Roger Daltrey! Still smashing it with The Who.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw, born in 1958, known for his 80s hits, celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Wouldn't It Be Good
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 69th birthday to the brilliant Nik Kershaw! Still an absolute legend of the 80s.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin, born in 1977, celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Yellow Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay's Chris Martin! A true stadium filler.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman and rock icon Jon Bon Jovi, born in 1962, celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Livin' on a Prayer
angles.copy: Whoa, we're halfway there! Happy 65th birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi!

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Chris Rea, born in 1951, would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Road to Hell
angles.copy: Thinking of Chris Rea today, who would have been 76. A unique voice we still miss.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: The Supremes co-founder Mary Wilson, born in 1944, would have celebrated her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Motown Legend
angles.copy: We're celebrating the life and music of Mary Wilson, who would have been 83 today. A true Motown legend.

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Gary Numan, born in 1958, celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Are 'Friends' Electric?
angles.copy: Are 'Friends' Electric? Happy 69th birthday to the iconic Gary Numan!
